\Section{Hybrid Inference}
\label{sec:hybrid}

Hybrid inference combines two sources of specifications: a mechanical \WP analysis, which is exact where it applies and stops at loops, and a coding agent, which proposes what the analysis cannot derive --- loop invariants and idiomatic, readable contracts --- and repairs against verifier feedback.
The verifier is the oracle for both.
We first walk through an inference session (Sec.~\ref{sec:example}), then describe the \WP analysis (Sec.~\ref{sec:wp}) and the tactics and skills that drive the agent (Sec.~\ref{sec:skills}).
